subject: Acme renewal & expansion recap — next steps and timeline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Johnson <sam.johnson@acme.com>, Priya Gupta <priya.g@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Acme renewal & expansion recap — next steps and timeline

Hi Sam / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap of what we covered and the proposed next steps so we’re all aligned. Please flag anything I missed.

Summary of current state / pain points
- Latency spikes during peak inference (esp. long-chat sessions) causing degraded UX for support agents.
- Rising per-token cost as usage of generation + embeddings grows; need better unit economics.
- Data residency / PII concerns for the new customer notes workload — evaluation of a private VPC/on-prem path.
- Need for higher throughput for nightly reranking jobs (batch embeddings + rerank).

Goals discussed
- Keep current hosted integration for customer support chat but reduce tail latency and cost.
- Pilot Dedicated capacity for reranking and bulk embedding generation to lower unit costs.
- Evaluate Private deployment for the customer notes project to satisfy compliance.

Proposed upsell path & timeline
1) Pilot Dedicated pool for batch reranking (Nov 2026) — 4–6 week trial, measure cost/latency improvements.
2) Expand Dedicated to handle nightly embedding jobs and reranking (Jan 2027) — amend renewal to include dedicated capacity.
3) Private deployment evaluation (Nov–Dec 2026) — security review and PoC; target production decision by 12/15/2026.

Action items (owners)
- Acme: share Q3 usage export and ideal SLAs for customer notes workload (Sam / Priya) — due 2026-10-09.
- Redwood: send compact proposal with pilot configuration and expected cost delta (Marissa) — sending v2 attached.
- Redwood CS: scope success criteria for pilot and monitoring dashboard (Michael) — will draft by 2026-10-12.
- Redwood Sales Ops: prepare contract amendment template and pricing options for Dedicated + Private (Rishi) — will have draft by 2026-11-01.

Attachments: I’ve attached a condensed usage report (exported) and our updated proposal (redwood_proposal_v2.pdf).

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0187

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear notes. Confirming we’ll:
- Share the Q3 usage export by Friday (I’ll include a breakdown by product line).
- Prioritize the customer notes workload SLA requirements — we need PII at-rest encryption and a 3-region residency constraint.

Couple of clarifications:
1) For the Dedicated pilot, can you outline expected cost savings vs. our current hosted spend for reranking (ballpark %)?
2) For the Private path, we’ll need a security questionnaire (SOC2 + penetration test report). Can you share the latest artifacts?

Priya and I are tentatively available for the kickoff the week of Nov 8.

Sam

Subject: Re: Acme renewal & expansion recap — attachments + answers

Sam — great, thanks for the quick turnaround. Short answers below and attachments included.

1) Expected savings for Dedicated pilot
- Based on your Q3 profile (see attached acme_q3_usage_report.xlsx) and our pilot config (4x A100-equivalent instances for nightly batch reranking), we project ~28–35% reduction in per-embedding and per-rerank job cost vs. current hosted spend — depending on batching effectiveness. We’ll include a sensitivity table in the proposal.

2) Security artifacts
- Attached: SOC 2 Type II summary and pen-test executive summary (redwood_proposal_v2.pdf includes links to full artifacts and our compliance pack). If you prefer direct transfer to your security team, we can share via secure Drive link or a protected DocuSign folder.

3) Pilot kickoff availability
- Nov 8 week works for us. Proposed 30-min kickoff to align scope, success criteria, and ingest steps.

Next steps
- I’ll update the proposal to include the sensitivity table and a 6-week pilot plan.
- Rishi, looping you for contracting and pricing options — can you confirm whether we can offer a pilot credit to accelerate evaluation?

Thanks,
Marissa

Thanks for keeping me in the loop — quick contracting note from Sales Ops.

We can offer a pilot credit covering the first 3 weeks of Dedicated pilot compute (up to $20k) to reduce Acme’s upfront evaluation cost. Pilot credit will be tied to a signed pilot SOW and a mutual success criteria doc. Post-pilot pricing will be the standard Dedicated rate; we’ll include tiered pricing for committed monthly throughput in the amendment.

Marissa — I’ll draft the pilot SOW and amendment template and share a first pass by 2026-11-01. Michael, please coordinate the success criteria dashboard that Acme will use (latency percentiles, cost/sample, throughput).
